about.heading: About IZA UI
about.intro: IZA UI is a one-person design-and-build studio. I take a project from a rough idea to a shipped, maintainable site — design system, frontend build, and the AI-assisted tooling that speeds up both.
about.howIWorkBody: Every project starts with a real conversation, not a template. I define a small token system (color, type, spacing, motion) first, then build the actual product against it — so what ships matches what was designed, pixel for pixel.
about.whatIBuildBodyPrefix: Marketing sites, product frontends, small design systems, and the occasional automation or bot on the side. See
